regulatory_bodies: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)

rules.name: Mandatory CDSCO Cosmetics Import Registration (Form 42 / COS-2)
rules.title: Mandatory CDSCO Cosmetics Import Registration (Form 42 / COS-2)
rules.directive_code: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 / Cosmetics Rules, 2020 (Rule 12)
rules.statute_citation: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 / Cosmetics Rules, 2020 (Rule 12)
rules.expected_requirement: Every imported cosmetic product must hold a valid Import Registration Certificate issued by CDSCO in Form COS-2.
rules.explanation: Commercial import of cosmetics into India without CDSCO registration certificate is prohibited under Rule 12. Indian Customs will seize unregistered consignments at port of entry.
rules.fix_suggestion: File application in Form COS-1 via CDSCO Sugam portal to obtain registration certificate COS-2 prior to shipment.

rules.name: Drugs and Magic Remedies Act Disease Treatment Prohibition
rules.title: Drugs and Magic Remedies Act Disease Treatment Prohibition
rules.directive_code: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954, Section 3
rules.statute_citation: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954, Section 3
rules.expected_requirement: Prohibition of advertisements suggesting diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment or prevention of specified diseases (including arthritis, rheumatism, cancer, hypertension).
rules.explanation: Claiming that an Ayurvedic, herbal, or cosmetic preparation permanently cures arthritis or chronic joint disease is a cognizable offense punishable by imprisonment.
rules.fix_suggestion: Remove all curative and disease treatment claims. Advertise strictly for general wellness, traditional topical comfort, or massage.

requirements.name: AYUSH Manufacturing License (if drug)
requirements.description: State AYUSH licensing for therapeutic Ayurvedic drugs.

rules.name: Toys (Quality Control) Order Mandatory BIS Certification & ISI Mark
rules.title: Toys (Quality Control) Order Mandatory BIS Certification & ISI Mark
rules.directive_code: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
rules.statute_citation: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
rules.expected_requirement: All toys imported or sold in India must conform to IS 9873 (Safety of Toys) and bear the Standard ISI Mark under a valid BIS license.
rules.explanation: Importing toys without BIS certification and ISI mark is illegal. Custom authorities conduct 100% sampling at Indian ports, and uncertified toys are confiscated or returned.
rules.fix_suggestion: Obtain BIS certification through Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS) and affix the ISI mark with valid CM/L number.

requirements.name: BIS ISI Mark License (IS 9873)
requirements.description: Valid BIS license number and ISI mark on product.

rules.name: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Mandatory Declarations
rules.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Mandatory Declarations
rules.expected_requirement: Mandatory declarations: Maximum Retail Price (MRP inclusive of all taxes), Month and Year of Manufacture/Import, Country of Origin, Net Quantity in standard SI metric units, and Consumer Care contact details.
rules.explanation: Selling imported consumer packaged goods without complete Legal Metrology declarations attracts penalties and product seizure under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
rules.fix_suggestion: Affix compliant Indian importer label containing MRP, origin, net quantity in metric, and consumer care email/phone.

requirements.name: Legal Metrology Importer Label
requirements.description: Complete Indian MRP and importer sticker.

rules.name: FSSAI Packaging Regulations for Food Contact Kitchenware
rules.title: FSSAI Packaging Regulations for Food Contact Kitchenware
rules.expected_requirement: Articles and wooden/bamboo utensils in contact with food must be food-grade, smooth, free from cracks, and not release contaminants exceeding limits under IS 9845.
rules.explanation: Kitchen cutting boards coated with toxic finishes or toxic adhesives violate FSSAI standards for food contact articles.
rules.fix_suggestion: Ensure cutting boards comply with IS 9845 overall migration standards and are finished with food-grade non-toxic oils.

rules.name: WPC Equipment Type Approval (ETA) & BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme
rules.title: WPC Equipment Type Approval (ETA) & BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme
rules.directive_code: Wireless Telegraphy Act / BIS Electronics & IT Goods (CRO) Order
rules.statute_citation: Wireless Telegraphy Act / BIS Electronics & IT Goods (CRO) Order
rules.expected_requirement: Wireless/Bluetooth consumer devices require Equipment Type Approval (ETA) from WPC, and rechargeable lithium power supplies require BIS CRS registration under IS 16046.
rules.explanation: Customs clearance of electronic devices with wireless transmitters or lithium batteries requires proof of WPC ETA and BIS CRS registration.
rules.fix_suggestion: Obtain WPC ETA approval for Bluetooth/RF modules and ensure battery conforms to IS 16046 with BIS CRS mark.

requirements.name: WPC ETA Approval & BIS CRS
requirements.description: WPC ETA certificate and BIS IS 16046 registration.

rules.name: CPCB Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) for E-Waste & Batteries
rules.title: CPCB Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) for E-Waste & Batteries
rules.directive_code: E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 / Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022
rules.statute_citation: E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 / Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022
rules.expected_requirement: Importers of electronic and electrical equipment and rechargeable batteries must be registered on the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) EPR portal.
rules.explanation: Customs authorities require valid EPR registration certificate from CPCB before clearing commercial consignments of electronics or batteries.
rules.fix_suggestion: Register as an importer on the CPCB EPR portal and fulfill annual recycling targets.
